channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period: AbbVie announced a $217M expansion of its Barceloneta plant (100 new jobs, up to $45.9M in DDEC incentives), PAC-TECH (Diesco, Dominican Republic) is adding a $12.7M line in Las Piedras, and Amazon opened its first Caribbean delivery station in Dorado. Further outside-capital signals include AZIO's role in a roughly $45M Army microgrid at Fort Buchanan, S&P's BBB+ rating on $193M of Aerostar bonds, and Avelo, Frontier and Air Canada adding routes. Risks center on energy: New Fortress Energy's LNG supply failure is pushing fuel costs up (a $90.9M reconciliation request), the PREPA revenue dispute is unresolved, and the permitting reform stalled until January. The Global Minimum Tax fix is still pending federal action, and Encanto's KFC/Taco Bell collapse cost about 2,600 jobs.
